headline: Inter-institutional task force fights illicit trade
summary: President Luis Abinader created a task force under Decree 818-26, signed November 16, to combat illicit trade and tax evasion. It also targets labor and migration irregularities that affect competition among commercial establishments.
why: Tax evasion and illicit trade reduce public revenue and put formal retailers at a competitive disadvantage against informal sellers.
original_headline: Fuerza de tarea interinstitucional combate comercio ilícito
